decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf belongs to the firm's core bakery and mill identity, the firm has publicly committed to it on its website, and with only one year on the market any weak results can still be blamed on start-up effects, so management persists.

The historic mill tour builds on the firm's heritage and needed visible investment in setup and promotion, so management stays committed and treats low early attendance as temporary while awareness grows.

The sweet pastry is less central to the firm's heritage and easier to replace in the assortment, but its recent public launch and the investment in its recipe lead management to give it more time rather than admit the decision failed.
